items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 19 at 10:16PM AKDT until May 20 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 10 to 20 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Juneau, City and Borough of Sitka, and
Western Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...From 1 PM to 7 PM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: City and Borough of Sitka; City and Borough of Juneau; Western Kupreanof and Kuiu Island
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make traveling difficult, especially for high
profile vessels. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 19 at 3:37PM AKDT until May 20 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* WHERE...Delta Junction and Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims
Camp.

* WHEN...Until 1 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.
Localized areas of blowing dust may reduce visibility.
items.areas: Delta Junction; Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
